name: treant
description: a Treant (Fall from Heaven), a tall walking tree: a brown gnarled bark body, a craggy bark face with a long nose ridge, glowing amber eyes and a leafy green beard, a bushy green leaf crown on its head, green leaves sprouting along its shoulders and long gnarled branch arms, each arm ending in a hand of long twig claws, and thick spreading root feet; no weapon: it attacks with the long twig claws of its LEFT hand (screen-right), and its RIGHT hand (screen-left) is an empty twig-clawed hand
hands: its weapon is the twig-clawed left hand on the screen-right side, hanging low with its long twig claws spread, and its right hand on the screen-left side is an empty twig-clawed hand hanging low at its side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear root leg, the trunk leans back, the twig-clawed left hand is lifted up over the head with its long twig claws pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the twig-clawed left hand cocked behind the head with its twig claws hanging down behind the leafy shoulders, the empty twig-clawed right hand tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front root foot steps toward the lower-right, the trunk whips forward, the left branch arm sweeps over the head and the twig-clawed hand reaches out level, its long twig claws pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: the left branch arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the long twig claws raking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty twig-clawed right hand swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the twig-clawed left hand carries on down until its claws nearly touch the ground at the lower-right, the trunk twisted, the leaf crown shaking
strike.6: recover: body rises, front root foot pulls back halfway, the twig-clawed left hand lifts back toward its low hanging rest

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the bark head snaps back toward the upper-left, amber eyes squeezed shut, the trunk jolts back, both branch arms jerk outward (the empty twig-clawed right hand flung out to the left, the twig-clawed left arm thrown out with its claws splayed), a few leaves shaken loose
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the twig-clawed left hand dipping, the empty twig-clawed right hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near root foot, body thrown back, the twig-clawed left arm flung up, the empty twig-clawed right hand drooping, leaves falling
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, the trunk slumps forward, the bark head droops, the twig-clawed hands lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the twig claws of the left hand resting on the ground, the right branch arm hanging
death.4: falling back: the trunk tips back toward the upper-left, the branch arms go limp and a twig snaps off the left hand, legs slide forward, leaves scattering
death.5: hits the ground: lying on its back along the ground, root feet toward the lower-right and the leafy head toward the upper-left, the branch arms sprawled limp; the snapped-off twig and fallen leaves lie on the ground at the lower-right; the leaf crown spread under its head
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the leaf crown and loose leaves settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on its back, the amber eyes dark, the branch arms limp, the snapped-off twig and fallen leaves on the ground beside it
